entries.note: Goldenberg 2009 (PMID 18941114, epub 2008-10-21) quote verbatim in abstract. Note the abstract itself says findings 'are consistent with activity in patients with NHL', so a stated comparison existed in 2008.

Morschhauser 2009 (PMID 19451441, epub 2009-05-18) quote verbatim. Registry exists: NCT00285428 (start 2004-09) and NCT00596804; drafter said not located. Peripheral B-cell depletion matches monkey depletion.
Engelberts 2020 (PMID 31981978) quote verbatim; FDA review lines ~1977-1981 confirm SC lower Cmax/cytokines, comparable depletion.
Hutchings 2021 (PMID 34508654) quote verbatim; 48 mg RP2D, MTD not reached, no grade>=3 CRS. Whether an SC-route claim counts as a 'regimen target' is borderline (see rule questions).

Li 2022 (PMID 35996883, epub 2022-09-27) quote verbatim; fit to escalation data and published a year after Hutchings 2021 named 48 mg RP2D, though abstract says it 'guided selection of 48 mg'. Retrodiction status is a rule question.

entries.rule: dose: target reached -> same; rule 6 dating = earliest public comparison
entries.note: Sinnollareddy 2026 (PMID 42541678) quote verbatim, but it updates a popPK model, not Li's PBPK/PD. Dose scores target reached: FL cohort dosed to 48 mg was public in Linton 2024 (or FDA 2023 E-R plateau), so date 2024.
entries.adjudication_note: Dose table: target reached -> same; reaching 48 mg, not the later plateau analysis (an efficacy matter), scores dose. Rule 6: date to Linton 2024 FL cohort dosed to 48 mg, not Sinnollareddy 2026.

entries.note: Stein 2004 (PMID 15102696) quote verbatim; abstract adds 'expected that in humans IMMU-106 should be at least as effective as rituximab'.

entries.rule: efficacy scores the trial's primary endpoint unless a secondary is a pre-specified poc_gate
entries.note: Quote verbatim, but registry NCT00285428 primary outcome is 'Safety and tolerance of different dose levels'; ORR was secondary, no poc_gate. Drafter excluded Hutchings 2021 FL ORR for the same reason; apply consistently.
entries.adjudication_note: Efficacy scores the trial's primary endpoint: NCT00285428 primary is 'Safety and tolerance of different dose levels', efficacy secondary, no poc_gate. Untested, untested_reason not_measured (rule 5), consistent with Hutchings 2021 handling.

entries.note: Engelberts 2020 quote verbatim; humanized-mouse models were non-FL lines/PDX (FDA review).
van der Horst 2021 (PMID 33602901, Feb 2021) quote verbatim; FL n=15, irrespective of prior CD20 mAb.
Li 2022 quote verbatim; FDA review (line ~9124) also describes model built on preclinical plus escalation data.
Linton 2024 (PMID 38889737) quote verbatim; pivotal FL cohort ORR is the primary endpoint. Class-level directional match from non-FL mouse models; acceptable.
Same Linton quote; ex-vivo prediction (activity irrespective of prior CD20 mAb) prospective vs pivotal FL cohort.
Same Linton quote. Model input included escalation FL patients (10 FL, 90% ORR), so prospectivity for the pivotal cohort is arguable; low confidence appropriate.
Quote verbatim in FDA BLA 761324 multidisciplinary review (bundle txt line 1978-1979); tier 2 correct; dated to Engelberts 2020.
Hutchings 2021 quote verbatim (CRS 59%, all grade 1-2). Monkey CRS prediction held. Linton 2024 FL: CRS 65% G1-2, 2% G3; neutropenia 25% G3-4 consistent with monkey 'reversible hematologic changes'.

Shi 2024 (PMC11245993) intro sentence on Daudi nude-mouse regression, equal to obinutuzumab, found verbatim; summary only, no figures or citation. Opening untested at 2019 proxy (first MIL62 trials) is acceptable.

entries.rule: same/contra from a pairing whose trial source attributes the result to conditions the model never tested should be untested (untested_reason: unsettled)
entries.note: ORR quote verbatim, but single-arm MIL62+lenalidomide; paper credits the combination (lenalidomide synergy) and the xenograft tested MIL62 alone in Burkitt Daudi. MIL62 monotherapy FL data (NCT04103905) are unpublished.
entries.adjudication_note: RULE QUESTION: can a single-arm trial of a class drug combined with a non-class active drug (lenalidomide) score efficacy for a monotherapy model, or is it untested/unsettled because the class drug's share is not isolated?

entries.note: FDA BLA 761324 review p.57: ProStorm soluble whole-blood assay (study 32318, non-GLP) quote verbatim. Not reported in Engelberts 2020 (monkey cytokines only), so first public 2023; 2017 opening proxy fine.

Hutchings 2021 abstract quote verbatim (CRS 59%, grade 1-2). Assay run pre-IND and filed, so prospective, not retro; dated 2023 when assay first public. Mixed B-NHL with FL subset; direction_only magnitude appropriate.

entries.rule: Dating (6): record registry_date; the registry lookup is mandatory
entries.note: Field registry_date: null -> 2006-02-02 (NCT00285428, IM-T-hA20-01 hA20 phase I in CD20+ NHL, start 2004-09, first posted 2006-02-02). Status and year unchanged by this fix.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule ('retro, never same'): same monkey data, whose run post-dated the reported phase I depletion (Goldenberg 2009), paired with that trial's paper; registry_date 2006-02-02 fix accepted.

entries.rule: Dating (6): record registry_date; the registry lookup is mandatory
entries.note: Field registry_date: null -> 2006-02-02 (NCT00285428 first posted 2006-02-02, start 2004-09). Status kept at the adjudicated untested (primary endpoint safety); only registry_date changes.
entries.adjudication_note: Efficacy scores the primary endpoint (NCT00285428 primary: safety/tolerance; no poc_gate), as adjudicated earlier; registry_date 2006-02-02 per rule 6. untested_reason not_measured already set.

entries.rule: Retrodiction: a model compared after the clinic knew the answer is retro, never same
entries.note: Abstract (epub 2008-10-21) does state the comparison: 'consistent with activity in patients with NHL given low IV or SC doses', so comparison_stated true. Phase I NCT00285428 began 2004-09; patient data already known, so retrodiction true, status retro not same.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule: Goldenberg 2009 says monkey studies 'have now confirmed' and 'corroborat[e] the activity observed in patients at very low doses', already reported; run after the clinic knew, reproduced it, so retro, comparison_stated.

missing: Veltuzumab phase I/II registry records NCT00285428 (start 2004-09, primary: safety/tolerance) and NCT00596804; the draft says the registry record was not located.

FDA BLA 761324 multidisciplinary review (2023) exposure-response: 'TMDD saturation was observed starting from 48 mg, due to a plateau in tumor killing' with full doses >48 mg not expected to add efficacy. This is an earlier public dose comparison than Sinnollareddy 2026, though in LBCL.

Goldenberg 2009 (doi:10.1182/blood-2008-07-168146) abstract states mouse/monkey findings 'are consistent with activity in patients with NHL given low intravenous or subcutaneous doses', which makes it a comparison_stated source, possibly a retrodiction.

MIL62: phase 1b/2 with lenalidomide in R/R FL/MZL (eClinicalMedicine 2024, sciencedirect pii S2589537024002815) and phase 3 NCT04834024 (MIL62+len vs len, PFS primary, status unknown, no results). No MIL62 preclinical model track was searched; any MIL62 xenograft paper would be its own track.

Imvotamab (IGM-2323): NCT04082936 terminated for 'Strategic Pipeline Prioritization' (not efficacy); phase 1 data only as meeting abstracts (e.g. EHA 2022 P1276, PMC9429641). No efficacy failure to add, but the context note could cite the termination reason.

MIL62 monotherapy phase I/II NCT04103905 in CD20+ NHL incl. FL/MZL (Shi 2024, eClinicalMedicine doi:10.1016/j.eclinm.2024.102702, reports ORR 'similar to obinutuzumab', FL data unpublished): the monotherapy test of the Daudi xenograft track once published.
rule_questions: Does a model's route recommendation (monkey SC vs IV lowers cytokine peaks with equal depletion) count as a 'regimen target' for dose, when humans were never dosed IV for comparison? The draft scores it same; the alternative is untested/no_prediction.

Is an in-silico PBPK/PD model fit to the same trial's escalation data, published after that trial named the 48 mg RP2D but said to have guided the choice, a retrodiction for dose (retro) and prospective for the later pivotal FL cohort's efficacy?

When the dose 'same' depends only on the target being reached, does the entry date to when FL patients were dosed to target (Linton 2024) or to when a later analysis confirmed the plateau the model stated (Sinnollareddy 2026)?
